blocking_methods.label: tollFree
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 1800-209-4333 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.

blocking_methods.label: alternate
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 020-6901-9000 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.
Email care@indusind.com from your registered email to request card blocking.
Log in to internet banking at https://www.indusind.com and use the card block/hotlist option.
Block via the bank's mobile app (Cards > Block/Hotlist). Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.org.indusind.indusapp | iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/indusind-bank/id389114565
